body:
# Rework brief: BUG-2696 / PR #4305, round 4 of 4 (CI-red fix, FINAL)

Advisor: claude-advisor-121, 2026-11-19 ~09:00 MST. Head: a5b4a5e (logic APPROVED by advisor-119 at 08:05).
Lane: Claude. Branch bug-2696-fresh. STRICT. Scope = make the full CI tier green. No other changes.

Full-tier CI run 44552563730 at a5b4a5e failed three tests:

1. lib-0 auto_bump_done_tests::bug_2696_r4_failing_store_probe_never_reports_propagation
   (auto_bump_done_tests.rs:6493): `git rev-parse HEAD failed: fatal: bad config line 1 in file .git/config`.
   This is the PR's OWN test and it fails in CI, not only on the lane. It reads head_sha after corrupting
   the store config. Capture the HEAD sha BEFORE corrupting the config (or corrupt something the
   rev-parse does not read). The assertion it guards must stay the same.

2. lib-0 pr_cmd::bug_2203_refs_subject_tests::bug_2203_refs_subject_ship_appends_no_trailer_and_completes_nothing
   (bug_2203_refs_subject_tests.rs:131): flips BUG-999 and BUG-2169 with prior_status Done on a Refs subject.
   Under the approved design D4/AC2, a DONE spec completes on a Refs landing, so the fixture contradicts it.
   Fix the TEST the same way TASK-1765 was handled: the fixture specs must be non-Done (e.g. Approved/In Progress),
   so the test still proves "a Refs subject never completes an open spec". Do NOT weaken it to a no-op:
   keep the assertion that the returned flip list is empty for non-Done Refs ids, and add one line asserting
   that a Done spec on a Refs subject DOES complete (D4).

3. lib-1 status_sections::bug_1633_pull_push_followups_tests::bug_1633_pull_followup_filed_only_remotely_is_not_refiled
   (bug_1633_pull_push_followups_tests.rs:461): the parent is no longer Completed after the pull. Find out WHY
   (likely slice_plan_outstanding now treats a child of the parent as an outstanding slice, or the parent
   was not Done). If the code is right under D1-D6, fix the fixture and say why in the commit body; if the
   new guard is wrong (e.g. counts a terminal child as outstanding, or a non-Parent edge), fix the code.

Run each of the three tests by name (one targeted cargo run), cargo fmt,
python3 scripts/check-store-writers.py, make check-ci-fast. Push. This is the last round; anything left
after it gets PARKED.
subject: BUG-2696 #4305: no park; launch r4 CI-fix on claude with brief .aida/tmp/brief-BUG-2696-r4-ci.md
